Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000758" [preference]: As of 2025-10-27, for the current Team Dune on-call cycle, page Tomasz Nowak for anything instead of Farah.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000746": As of 2025-10-22, Farah is Team Dune's release captain for Q3 2025.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000742": Team Dune decided the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000739" [decision]: On 2025-10-22, Team Dune decided that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys.  (about: Team Dune, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000719": As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000715": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000661": As of 2025-09-08, billing-api has a new dependency on the feature-flags service.  (about: billing service, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000642": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000514": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, resizer)
- memory_id "1000455": As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000439": The scheduler's previous single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000436" [decision]: On 2025-06-13, the Ember team decided the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000430": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000391" [decision]: As of 2025-05-09, Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000367" [constraint]: The billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000278": The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run.  (about: feature-flags service, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000240" [constraint]: The scheduler deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000237" [constraint]: The webhooks service only ships on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000189" [constraint]: The reporting service can be released on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000098": Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
